def: Google's agent-first development platform, launched in November 2025 as an agentic IDE and extended in May 2026 with the Antigravity 2.0 desktop app and the Go-based Antigravity CLI.
practice: Antigravity CLI shares the desktop app's agent harness and replaced Gemini CLI for consumer tiers; Agent Skills, hooks, subagents and extensions (renamed Antigravity plugins) carried over, without full parity at launch (as of November 2026).
